derivation.auditor_key: (sk, pk) = DeriveKeyPair(SHA-256("edicta/policy/v1 test auditor|" + name)), RFC 9180 section 7.1.3; kid = ASCII(name)
derivation.ephemeral_key: skE = DeriveKeyPair(SHA-256("edicta/policy/v1 test private ephemeral|" + label + "|" + index)).sk; index is the 0-based auditor position
derivation.aead_nonce: SHA-256("edicta/policy/v1 test private aead nonce|" + label)[0:12]
derivation.label: decimal plaintext_kind + "/" + hash hex (the record key)
derivation.note: Production draws all of these from a CSPRNG. Rejects reuse the PrivatePart envelope's randomness.

reject.description: Private form plus prev_state in clear (keys 13, 19, 20).
Private-form allow whose prev_state_hash is the genesis hash, with keys 15 and 16.
Private-form allow whose prev_state_hash is not the genesis hash, without keys 15 and 16.
An envelope of 65,537 bytes, one above the private cap: refused before decoding.
The last ciphertext byte flipped: the DEK unwraps with a listed key, the AEAD fails.
Sealed with the core payload AEAD tag (edicta/v0/payload) as aad: the DEK unwraps, the AEAD fails.
DEK wrapped with the core HPKE info (edicta/v0/payload-dek): no entry unwraps with the policy info, so nothing opens.

cases.description: Private mandate; auditor-2's key opens the mandate, the PrivateParts, the closed bucket and the ClosedSets; fast check and walk p4 -> genesis as in public mode.
No auditor key: facts and anchor_time pass, the rest is policy_private.
A key the envelopes do not list (auditor-3): nothing opens, policy_private.
The record under p4's private_hash opens to another PrivatePart (genesis): its hash differs from the key, source_corrupt.
Full walk without the key: L1 and L2 on public fields (key 20) down to the genesis hash; gate_integrity unchecked (policy_private), never ok.
No key; the gate signed amount 100, the action bytes say 1000.
No key; anchor_time 60 s after the verified T_ref.
The PrivatePart opens and hashes to private_hash, but its state does not hash to the signed prev_state_hash (key 20).
The mandate has auditors but the allow verdict carries prev_state in clear (public form).
Two private-form allows with the same mandate_hash and the same prev_state_hash (genesis), different commitments; q1x is evidence. No key: the hash form of the fork rule.
